proposed.title: X-Men '97#4
proposed.text: Mojo pulls Jubilee and Roberto into a video game built from her old adventures. With help from a digital copy of herself, she beats him and gets them both home.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Traps Jubilee in a video game of her own adventures.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Escapes Mojo's video game and beats him.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 S1 'Motendo' (#4): Jubilee and Roberto are pulled into a video game based on her previous adventures, created by Mojo; with Abscissa's help they defeat Mojo and return to the real world. Both are on screen after the last stage (TAS#36) and this is a new clash between them.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#34
proposed.text: Grieving the loss of Jean, Scott lashes out at Xavier and quits the X-Men. He comes back with his faith in Xavier's ideals renewed.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader. Quits in grief over Jean, then returns.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor. Scott walks out on him, then comes back.

changes.evidence: TAS 'No Mutant Is an Island' (#34): Cyclops cannot move past his grief over Jean, lashes out at Xavier, strips off his uniform and throws it at the professor's feet; after stopping Killgrave at his old orphanage he returns to the X-Men with renewed faith in Xavier's ideals. A falling-out and reconciliation with no stage (only stage is TAS#1).

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#55
proposed.text: Fitzroy travels back to 1959 and kills the young Xavier. Bishop, Shard, Storm and Wolverine go back to just before it happens and save his life.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Travels back to 1959 to save Xavier's life.

changes.evidence: TAS 'One Man's Worth' (#54-55): Fitzroy, Bantam and Nimrod go back to 1959 and kill Xavier; in Part 2 Bishop, Shard, Storm and Wolverine convince Forge, go back a few minutes before Xavier dies and save him, restoring the timeline. The connection starts here, well before the current first stage (X-Men '97#14). (Xavier also probes Bishop's mind in TAS#12 to confirm he is from the future.)
